name: darkness aura
desc: Magical Darkness fills a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=amat5Ii4NydseA0h]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name]]{monster}. This effect lasts while the [[lookup @name]]{monster} maintains Concentration on it, up to [[lookup @duration.value activity=amat5Ii4NydseA0h]] minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.
